description: Concepts that last years: retrieval, evals, loops, injection, governance layers. Taught in the body of each lesson.
Names, versions, laws, prices and vendor features. Kept in dated status boxes and in this changelog.
Every quarter the status boxes are checked against primary sources and the changelog gets a new section.
One dated line: what changed and which modules it touches. Superseded entries stay as history.
The same practice for your own system: model snapshots, protocol revisions, SDK versions and policies, reviewed on a fixed cadence.
